name: Weeping Woman
description: A gold-masked dead woman of Asphodel who, in an endless search for her dead, lures living children away.

timeline.summary: The phalanx leader reports to Perisophia and the council that the Weeping Woman is no longer alone and leads three masked children.
timeline.quote: We have again seen the Weeping Woman. And... she is no longer alone.

timeline.summary: Perisophia deduces that the Weeping Woman has lured the missing children away and decides the children must be laid to rest.
timeline.quote: In her endless search for her dead, the Weeping Woman has lured away the living.

timeline.summary: At the salt marsh the priests chant while the young widower pours the lekythos into the water, drawing the Weeping Woman and children from the mist.
timeline.quote: Then, out of the mists, she came.

timeline.summary: The priests lay blood-wet palms on the golden masks, and the four masked figures slip below the surface of the fen.
timeline.quote: And with a sigh, four masked figures slipped below the surface.

pages_say.description: A gold-masked dead woman of Asphodel who, in an endless search for her dead, lures living children away.
